left.title: The supervision surface draws what the design compiled, at 100x30 and at the 80x24 floor
Every command the catalogue declares for the menu bar is actually rendered in it
A supervision client can read the machine's readiness, switches and history, not only its run and queue
A session attaches to a macOS guest and executes its steps inside that guest; the host agent routes calls over
Guest attachments are held against a counted lane whose capacity is a parameter: macOS at two, one session per
The pool never evicts: a guest a person started, or one another session holds, is waited for and never stopped
A guest's witness tier is derived from the platform its provider reports, so a provider saying darwin yields m
